purpose: Private postseal annotated-spatial identity-boundary review, no training or G retuning
selection: Per each of the5 declared cohort scenes, partition only by scorer-provided identity_diagnostic.annotated_spatially_confirmed; sort each partition by SHA256(salt|id) then id, select up to2 per partition. No IoU magnitude, delta, modelscore, color, caption or G-acceptance selection.
insufficient_stratum: Keep actual0/1/2 counts; do not replace from another scene/status or choose a success/failure

status_meaning.confirmed: scorer-defined annotated-spatially-confirmed only, never semantic instance identity proof
status_meaning.unconfirmed: Condition not established, not a wrong-identity label; preserve no_other_annotation and inventory-exhaustiveness flags

status_definition_owner: Independent postseal scorer, unchanged thresholds/inventory rules; visualizer never recalculates or changes classification
source_prediction_contract: Same R9 normal cache q_source fixedq0 and mode rgb_fulltext__direct_G; no R8 outputcache/query reuse, no alternate query chosen by GT
GT_source_contract: Postrelease scorer emits separately sealed PRIVATE sidecar with model-coordinate GT7D and transform helper SHA; no GT fields in9key modelmanifest or normal G inputs
GT_helper_semantics: Drone rawZ+=1.8 then first7 float32; Quad first7 float32; preserve yaw(radians), do not invent pitch/roll meaning for extra2. Renderer receives model-coordinate GT7D and never reapplies zshift.
projection: GT local +/-size/2 rotated by audited yaw_matrix then add transformed center; source/direct nativeyaw0; project_model_points once: Drone E@undo_model_z, QuadE. Explicit assume_zero_declared missingD, same original imageW/H.
figure: Full literal caption without text truncation, explicit source(q0)/directG/GT color legend, original RGB and observed-point support, diagnostic status and incomplete-annotation boundary. No GT-corrected model predictions.
display_size_policy: Use saved evaluation-clamped source/direct dimensions if raw nonpositive; disclose clamp count, never rewrite original caches. Positive GT sizes required.
release_gate: Before any actual cache/score/GT-sidecar/media read: root-bound normalpredictionseal+GT_SCORE_RELEASE+scoredseal+privateGTsidecarseal+manifest+helper+renderer hashes must be verified. Schema-binding final adapter not implemented or executed in this preparation.
private_outputs: Figures, full captions, model/GT coordinates, raw IDs and originalscene names remain local; only aggregate review/scalar/hash receipt can be public. No identity-map export.
current_preparation: Plan and pure-array/synthetic rendering only; no actual GT, score, cache or target media read
exposure: Historically researched R5/R7/R8 targetVAL; selected GT-conditioned strata are descriptive, not fresh holdout/causal identity labels
